items.text: Coding gives you a window into what the future will look like for a large amount of knowledge work. The first step for most jobs is that we go from doing most of the research, typing, and value creation manually (even if it’s using digital tools) to soon coordinating the work that agents are doing. Next, as this step itself becomes redundant or slows down what agents are capable of, we will be giving agents goals to optimize against and they’ll go off on and increasingly solve larger problems for us. items.title: AI native teams will eventually force the surrounding organization to become AI native too
items.text: AI native teams will eventually force the surrounding organization to become AI native too. Take software development. coding velocity is way up thanks to AI, while actual shipped products and business impact are unchanged in most companies. That’s cos the surrounding system of experimentation tooling, evaluation, launch processes, and gtm are outdated. It’s like sticking a Ferrari engine in a sedan and racing it on Indian roads. The engine can rev faster but the car speed is limited by its system and environment. AI native companies were built ground up for this new way of building and shipping.
